passwords.note: Seasonal word plus a year tacked on is a predictable pattern, so it shows up in leaks often enough to be uncommon rather than unique.
Short, dictionary-word passwords like "store" get tried first and turn up in leak lists over and over.
Drpepper is a famous soda brand name, and people reach for it as a simple, memorable word with no digits or symbols.
Pairing a team nickname with the sequence "123" is a predictable combo many people reach for.
Real Madrid with "3" for "e" and "@" for "a", a disguise few people bother with.
